Alistar.watch: Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize can force movement and knock you up at close range, while Alistar E Trample stuns. Near a turret, don’t give Alistar room to circle behind you and knock you into turret range. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, Alistar takes reduced damage, so back off and wait out its duration.
Alistar.build: Alistar Q Pulverize, Alistar W Headbutt, and Alistar E Trample all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If you are dying while locked down by crowd control, also prioritize tenacity. Braum W Stand Behind Me raises the magic resistance of both Braum and the ally he leaps to, so use it to leap to an ally just before the damage lands.
Alistar.fight: Counterattack right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize have been used. When you have a clear angle between minions, land Braum Q Winter's Bite to slow the target and apply the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows. Basic attack the same target as your allied marksman to trigger the stun. Do not focus damage on Alistar while Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active.
Alistar.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter’s Bite when the enemy steps up for a last hit or there’s a gap between minions. If it misses, don’t overextend for a basic attack; wait for the next opportunity. Hold space near your allied marksman and maintain vision around the river and bushes. Near a turret, block Alistar’s angle to circle behind you.
Alistar.combo: Once Alistar W Headbutt has been used, apply the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Basic attack the same target as your ally to trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun. If Braum R Glacial Fissure knocks the target up, follow with Braum Q Winter's Bite and a basic attack just before they land to give Alistar less room to escape with Alistar W Headbutt.
Alistar.escape: Alistar W Headbutt is Alistar's only mobility tool, so immediately after he uses it is Braum's window to close the gap. If Alistar Q Pulverize has also been used, close in with Braum W Stand Behind Me and look for Braum R Glacial Fissure. While both abilities are unavailable, you can also push the lane or reposition.
Alistar.phase: Braum remains strong through the mid game, so look for counterattack opportunities with your allied marksman. In the late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so fight while protecting a fed ally.

Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is a cone-shaped slowing poke, so dodge sideways and block projectiles headed toward an ally with Braum E Unbreakable. Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with every basic attack, so do not stay within basic attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, do not start a skirmish from outside your vision. If the arrow comes, face Braum E Unbreakable toward it.
Ashe.build: Ashe P Frost Shot, Ashe Q Ranger's Focus, and Ashe W Volley deal primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow deals magic damage, so armor alone will not protect you from it. Since Ashe's damage relies on basic attacks and attack speed, reducing her attack speed is also effective.
Ashe.fight: Right after Ashe W Volley has been used, start a trade with Braum Q Winter's Bite if a clear angle opens between minions. Basic attack the target with your ally to trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, then close in again after it ends.
Ashe.laning: When Ashe steps forward to last hit, look for an angle to land Braum Q Winter's Bite without a minion blocking it. If you miss, back off instead of forcing your way in for a basic attack. Stay near your allied marksman and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Ashe.combo: Slow Ashe and apply the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Basic attack the same target as your ally to trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun. If you knock Ashe up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before she lands to continue the slow and stacks.
Ashe.escape: A good time to approach is after Ashe W Volley has been used and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended. Ashe has no mobility ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and pin her down with Braum R Glacial Fissure. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, account for its stun when engaging.
Ashe.phase: Early on, Braum can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but must avoid the slowing poke from Ashe W Volley. Braum remains strong through the mid game as he builds defensive items, so look for angles to reach Ashe with your allies. In the late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so focus on protecting a fed ally and triggering marks together.
Ashe.teamfight: Stand between your backline and Ashe, and face Braum E Unbreakable toward Ashe's incoming projectiles. Stay beside your allies and use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies who engage to break their formation, rather than diving deep first.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so do not stand with your back to a wall or in line with an ally or minion. Watch your flanks because Bard can enter from the side with Bard E Magical Journey. Attack targets caught by Bard R Tempered Fate after their damage immunity ends.
Bard.build: You can easily take focused damage after the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding, so get tenacity first. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand the damage from Bard P Traveler's Call and Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Bard.fight: When a clear angle opens between minions or Bard steps forward, land Braum Q Winter's Bite to slow him and apply the first stack. If it hits, basic attack the same target as your ally to trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun. If it misses, back off and wait for the next chance.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey has been used, land Braum Q Winter's Bite to slow Bard and apply the first stack, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Basic attack the same target as your ally to trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun. If you knock Bard up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, follow with Braum Q Winter's Bite just before he lands.
Bard.escape: Right after you force Bard to use Bard E Magical Journey is Braum's chance to engage. Use an ally or minion to close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then use Braum R Glacial Fissure to cut off Bard's escape route.
Bard.phase: Braum is fairly strong early because he can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite. In the late game, he deals little damage on his own, so protect a fed ally and fight alongside them.
Bard.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy carries, and use Braum R Glacial Fissure on engaging enemies to break their formation. If an ally is threatened, slow the enemy on them with Braum Q Winter's Bite, leap to the ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then face Braum E Unbreakable toward the threat.
Bard.laning: If Bard W Caretaker's Shrine appears in lane, step on it to destroy it and prevent Bard's allies from healing.

Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target in its path, so stand behind minions and face Braum E Unbreakable toward the incoming grab. A grab can be followed by the knockup from Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field, so avoid the grab angle in the first place.
Blitzcrank.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. The main danger is being locked down by crowd control after a grab, so consider tenacity too, and account for Blitzcrank R Static Field destroying shields.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses. Land Braum Q Winter's Bite through a gap between minions to slow the target and apply the first stack, then basic attack the same target as your ally to trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun.
Blitzcrank.laning: Keep minions in front of you to block Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. If you lack vision of a bush, stay well away from it. Push the lane or start a trade with Braum Q Winter's Bite when the grab misses or Blitzcrank is low on mana.
Blitzcrank.combo: Once Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab has been used, apply the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Basic attack the same target with your ally to trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun. If Braum R Glacial Fissure knocks the target up, follow with Braum Q Winter's Bite just before they land.
Blitzcrank.escape: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab missing is your chance to engage. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and pin him down with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, Braum can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but stay behind minions to avoid Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Protect your allies and fight with them through the mid game. In the late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so fight beside your allied marksman.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy carries, and face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threats. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on engaging enemies to break their formation. If an ally gets caught, slow the enemy with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to the ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to protect them.

Brand.watch: If you are affected by Brand P Blaze, Brand Q Sear will stun you, and consecutive spell hits will stack Blaze until it explodes. If you are burning, move out of Q's projectile path or hide behind minions, and face the incoming projectile with Braum E Unbreakable. Walk out of Brand W Pillar of Flame's marked area, and spread out from allies when you see Brand R Pyroclasm.
Brand.build: Build magic resistance first against Brand's damage and Brand P Blaze. Get movement speed to escape marked area attacks instead of stacking only health.
Brand.fight: Trade after Brand W Pillar of Flame is used, while Brand remains in range. Hit Braum Q Winter's Bite through a gap between minions to apply a slow and the first stack, then coordinate with an ally to basic attack the same target. If Q misses, back off instead of forcing an engage.
Brand.laning: Do not stand next to burning minions. If the wave is burning, move to the side. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when Brand steps up for a last hit or a gap opens between minions. Stay near your allied marksman in lane and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Brand.combo: Apply the first stack to Brand with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then jump to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Follow with your and your ally's basic attacks to stack Braum P Concussive Blows and stun him. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Q just before he lands, then follow with basic attacks.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility spell, so the moment after he uses Brand W Pillar of Flame is an opening to engage. If you are burning, avoid the stun from Brand Q Sear or wait for the burn to end, then close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Once close, knock him up with Braum R Glacial Fissure to give him less room to escape.
Brand.phase: Early on, Braum can start a trade with one Braum Q Winter's Bite, but must avoid stacking Brand P Blaze. In the late game, Braum deals little damage alone, so protect a fed ally and fight together.
Brand.teamfight: Stand between your backline and Brand, but keep space between yourself and allies to prevent Brand E Conflagration from spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm from bouncing. If an ally is burning, do not stand beside them. Face incoming projectiles with Braum E Unbreakable. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies who engage to split their formation, and use its lingering slow zone to block the path of enemies following up.

Heimerdinger.watch: When Heimerdinger W Hextech Micro-Rockets come in, face the rockets with Braum E Unbreakable to shield your allies. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available, watch for empowered grenades and rockets, and avoid grouping in tight spaces.
Heimerdinger.build: Heimerdinger's turrets, rockets, and grenades all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Get movement speed to escape their marked attack areas; there is no reason to prioritize armor against these abilities.
Heimerdinger.laning: Do not overstay within turret range. Wait until a grenade or turret placement charge has been used. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or Heimerdinger steps forward; back off if it misses. Stay near your allied marksman and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Heimerdinger.combo: Apply a slow and the first mark to Heimerdinger with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then jump to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Basic attack the same target with your ally to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Braum Q Winter's Bite just before he lands to keep him controlled.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no spell to create distance on his own, so use Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap and Braum R Glacial Fissure to catch him.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Braum can start a trade with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but choose your opening carefully inside Heimerdinger's turret range so you do not take rockets as well. Later, Braum deals little damage alone, so protect an ally who has scaled and fight together.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: Stand between your backline and Heimerdinger, and face incoming rockets with Braum E Unbreakable. If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available, position so your allies do not group in a narrow passage or at one spot near an objective. When enemies engage, use Braum R Glacial Fissure to split their formation and place its lingering slow zone along the path of enemies following up.

Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, you may take follow-up damage, so do not rush an engage while it is available. If Hwei's first spell hits you, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on health alone to withstand it.
Hwei.build: Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Hwei's damage. Use Braum W Stand Behind Me to raise your and an ally's magic resistance when damage is incoming. If Hwei E Subject: Torment catches your allied marksman and leads to follow-up damage, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Hwei.fight: The moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear is an opening to engage. Hit Braum Q Winter's Bite through a gap between minions to apply a slow and the first mark, then call the target for your ally to basic attack and trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Q misses, back off instead of forcing your way in for basic attacks.
Hwei.laning: Look for a Braum Q Winter's Bite angle when an opponent steps up for a last hit or a gap opens between minions. If Hwei has placed an eye, change your path to avoid the root or put a minion in front of you. Hold space and vision near your allied marksman, and move immediately if Hwei's first spell hits you.
Hwei.combo: Once Hwei E Subject: Torment is used, apply a slow and the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite. Jump to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap, then basic attack with your ally to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Q just before he lands and follow with basic attacks.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility spell, so close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. If E is still available, check before engaging: you could be rooted or pushed away at the front. Once close, knock him up with Braum R Glacial Fissure and leave a slow zone to narrow his escape path.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Braum can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, so coordinate with your ally to pressure the marked target. In the mid game, use Braum R Glacial Fissure to engage and control space, along with your accumulated defensive items. Late in the game, Braum's own damage falls short, so protect a fed ally and focus on stuns and blocking projectiles.

Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks Braum up and stops his engage. If you hear the whirlwind from a bush or outside vision, avoid its path; if you know its incoming direction, face it with Braum E Unbreakable. Janna R Monsoon pushes nearby enemies away, so account for it when engaging.
Janna.fight: Do not focus damage on a target shielded by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Engage after the shield is gone. If Janna is isolated, look for an ally or minion to jump to with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap.
Janna.laning: Pressure the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when an opponent steps up for a last hit or a gap opens between minions. If Q misses, back off instead of forcing an engage, and maintain vision near your allied marksman.
Janna.combo: Apply a slow and the first mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then jump to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Basic attack the same target with your ally to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock Janna up with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Q just before she lands to continue the slow and mark.
Janna.escape: A missed Janna Q Howling Gale is an opening to engage. If Janna E Eye Of The Storm has also been used, apply a mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then use an ally or minion as a jump target for Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, account for the possibility that it will push your engage away.
Janna.phase: Late in the game, Braum deals little damage alone, so focus on protecting a fed ally.
Janna.teamfight: Beside your allied marksman, face the opposing damage dealer with Braum E Unbreakable and use Braum Q Winter's Bite and Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies who engage. Place R's fissure along the path of enemies following up to split their formation. If Janna is behind an allied damage dealer, she can push your engage away, so establish vision and look for a moment when she is isolated.

Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade passes through targets in a straight line and dashes to the last champion hit, so do not stand in line with your ADC. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so keep her from getting close. When the indicator for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun.
Leona.build: If Leona's crowd control catches your ADC, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier. Magic resistance helps against Leona's own damage, but choose resistances for the damage type of the enemy carry dealing damage during the lockdown.
Leona.fight: Counterattack right after Leona E Zenith Blade is used. Apply a slow and the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then attack the same target as your ADC to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its area before it detonates.
Leona.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or an enemy steps up to last-hit. If Q misses, back off and wait for its cooldown instead of forcing your way in for an auto attack. Stay near your ADC and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Leona.combo: When Leona closes in, apply a slow and the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to your ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me and face Braum E Unbreakable toward the threat. When engaging after Leona E Zenith Blade is used, close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and knock her up with Braum R Glacial Fissure. Follow with Braum Q Winter's Bite and an auto attack, then have your ally's auto attacks build the stacks of Braum P Concussive Blows.
Leona.escape: The opening to engage is right after Leona E Zenith Blade, Leona's only mobility tool, is used. Close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and land Braum R Glacial Fissure; Leona will have trouble escaping.
Leona.phase: Late game, Braum deals little damage himself, so focus on protecting allies who have scaled.
Leona.teamfight: Wait beside your ADC for Leona to engage, then use Braum R Glacial Fissure on the enemy who closes in to break up their formation and cut off reinforcements. Use Braum W Stand Behind Me to reach your ally and increase defensive stats, then face Braum E Unbreakable toward the enemy ADC's incoming projectiles. If you are marked by Leona P Sunlight, back off instead of moving forward, as follow-up enemy damage may be coming.

Karma.watch: When Karma Q Inner Flame comes your way, face Braum E Unbreakable toward Karma to block the projectile. Immediately walk out of the area left by an empowered Karma Q Inner Flame when it detonates. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move away to break the tether before it roots you. If Karma E Inspire is empowered by Karma R Mantra and shields nearby allies, delay your engage until the shields end.
Karma.build: Karma's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Prioritize movement speed as well to escape the area left by Karma Q Inner Flame and the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve. If Karma W Focused Resolve is holding your ADC in place, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Karma.fight: Draw out Karma W Focused Resolve, then start the fight after the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra ends. Apply a slow and the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then attack the same target as your ADC to complete the stun. Karma tends to have low magic resistance, so Braum's magic damage lands well too.
Karma.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or Karma steps up to last-hit. If it hits, attack the marked target with your ADC; if it misses, back off instead of forcing your way in. Move behind minions or out of range so Karma Q Inner Flame cannot hit you for free and let Karma P Gathering Fire bring Karma R Mantra back sooner.
Karma.combo: Apply a slow and the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows with your auto attack and your ally's auto attacks.
Karma.escape: Your chance to engage comes after you bait out Karma W Focused Resolve by spacing around it. If the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has also ended, close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and catch Karma with Braum R Glacial Fissure. If Karma W Focused Resolve has already connected, first move away to break the tether.
Karma.phase: Braum stays strong through mid game as he builds defensive items, so avoid Karma's poke and complete stuns with your ally. Late game, Braum deals little damage himself, so focus on protecting your ADC.
Karma.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy carry, facing Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming Karma Q Inner Flame. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, draw it out by controlling your distance, then engage after the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra ends. If an enemy reaches your ally, protect them with Braum Q Winter's Bite and Braum W Stand Behind Me, then break up the enemy formation with Braum R Glacial Fissure.

Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy prevents you from attacking or using abilities, so do not engage with Braum W Stand Behind Me while it is available. Lulu R Wild Growth increases its target's health and knocks up nearby enemies, so do not commit all your attacks to that target while it is available.
Lulu.build: The source does not specify a particular item to buy early. Choose resistances for the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting, and build magic resistance if you need to withstand Lulu's magic damage. Also consider tenacity against the crowd control from Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the extra bolts from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. When an enemy steps up to last-hit, look for an angle to land Braum Q Winter's Bite without a minion blocking it; if it misses, do not force your way in. Stay near your ADC and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Lulu.combo: Apply a slow and the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Build the stacks of Braum P Concussive Blows with your ally's auto attacks to stun the target. If Lulu is far away, knock her up with Braum R Glacial Fissure, then follow with Braum Q Winter's Bite.
Lulu.escape: Lulu has no dash to create distance on her own, so engage right after Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally. Close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and lock her down with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Lulu.phase: Braum stays strong through mid game as he builds defensive items, but his impact falls off late game if his allies have not scaled.
Lulu.teamfight: Stand beside your ADC between them and the enemy carry, and face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threats to block projectiles. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on an engaging enemy to break up their formation, and place its lingering slow zone in the path of enemy reinforcements. If Lulu R Wild Growth is still available, target Lulu herself or someone else instead of counting on a guaranteed kill against the ally she is protecting.

Lux.watch: Getting hit by Lux Q Light Binding makes you vulnerable to her follow-up abilities, so dodge when you see her cast it or face Braum E Unbreakable toward Lux to block it. If one of Lux's abilities hits you, retreat beyond auto attack range before she triggers Lux P Illumination with an auto attack. When the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears, dodge sideways.
Lux.build: If Lux Q Light Binding catches your ADC and they take follow-up attacks, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against Lux's magic damage, and get movement speed to escape the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, or block it with Braum E Unbreakable, before starting a fight. Apply the first stack to Lux with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me when your ally can auto attack the same target.
Lux.laning: Lux Q Light Binding can hit the first two enemies, so do not stand in line with your ADC. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or Lux steps forward; if it misses, do not force your way in. Stay near your ally and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding is used, apply a slow and the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows with Braum Q Winter's Bite. If you knock the target up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before they land to continue the slow and stacking.
Lux.escape: Engage right after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability, so leap to an ally or minion with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap, then catch her with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Lux.phase: Early on, Braum can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but you need to dodge Lux Q Light Binding first and attack the same target as your ally to follow up with a stun. Late game, Braum deals little damage alone, so focus on protecting allies who have scaled.
Lux.teamfight: Stand between your ADC and the enemy carry, facing Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming Lux Q Light Binding. Take a different approach angle from your ally so Lux E Lucent Singularity does not catch you both. If an enemy engages on your ally, break up their formation with Braum R Glacial Fissure and use its lingering slow zone to delay reinforcements.

Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance makes him untargetable during the dash and roots on landing, so use your abilities after he lands. Stay out of bushes planted with Maokai E Sapling Toss. If a sapling chases you, lead it toward minions or monsters instead of allies. The root from Maokai R Nature's Grasp lasts longer when it comes from farther away, so dodge perpendicular to its path and fight in open ground.
Maokai.build: If Maokai W Twisted Advance and Maokai R Nature's Grasp catch your allied marksman, get Mikael's Blessing earlier. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Maokai's ability damage, but choose resistances for the enemy damage dealer who will attack while Maokai holds a target down. Maokai Q Bramble Smash deals damage based on maximum health, so consider tenacity and movement speed instead of stacking only health.
Maokai.fight: While Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, stay out of its range near bushes. Avoid unnecessary ability poke on Maokai so you do not repeatedly trigger the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic.
Maokai.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or the enemy damage dealer steps up to last hit. If it lands, attack the same target as your ally to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If it misses, back off and wait for the next chance. Watch for saplings in bushes, stay near your allied marksman, and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Maokai.combo: Once Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, hit the enemy damage dealer with Braum Q Winter's Bite. Use Braum W Stand Behind Me to jump to a forward minion or ally, then stack Braum P Concussive Blows with your ally's basic attacks.
Maokai.escape: The opening to engage comes immediately after you make Maokai use Maokai W Twisted Advance.
Maokai.phase: Early on, Braum can start a trade with one Braum Q Winter's Bite, but watch your engage distance if Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready. Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so focus on protecting allies who have scaled.
Maokai.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy damage dealer. If Maokai reaches an ally, slow him with Braum Q Winter's Bite and jump to the ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles from the enemy marksman. Avoid narrow passages when Maokai R Nature's Grasp is coming, and place the slow zone from Braum R Glacial Fissure along the enemy's follow-up route.

Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first target it hits, so do not force your way in until Milio uses it. Delay fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire extends the enemy marksman's range. Milio R Breath of Life can remove stuns but cannot remove knockups.
Milio.build: Choose resistances for the enemy damage dealer's damage type, not Milio alone. If Milio's healing prolongs fights, get a source of healing reduction.
Milio.fight: When a gap opens between minions, hit Milio with Braum Q Winter's Bite to apply a slow and the first mark. Attack the same target as your allied marksman to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, do not force a chase.
Milio.laning: Early on, look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when an enemy steps up to last hit. If it lands, apply brief pressure with your ally. Account for the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire: pressure their mana through a war of attrition and take control of the wave. Stay in lane to protect your allied marksman, and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Milio.combo: Once Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, apply a slow and the first mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then close the gap by jumping to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Follow with your basic attacks and your ally's to stack Braum P Concussive Blows. If Braum R Glacial Fissure knocks the target up, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before they land to follow up with a slow and mark.
Milio.escape: Immediately after Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down is your chance to close the gap. Milio has no mobility ability, so use Braum W Stand Behind Me to approach through an ally or minion, then lock him down with the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Milio.phase: Early laning is a strong period for Braum to start fights with Braum Q Winter's Bite, so look to take control. Braum remains strong through mid game as he builds defensive items. As the game goes on, Milio's team composition grows stronger and Braum depends more on his allies' growth, so focus on protecting your damage dealers late.
Milio.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy damage dealer, and face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threats to block projectiles. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies engaging to break up their formation and leave its slow zone along the enemy's follow-up route. If you get a chance to reach Milio, target him directly; even with Milio R Breath of Life, the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure cannot be removed.

Morgana.watch: Getting hit by Morgana Q Dark Binding lets Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks connect, so move with minions between you and her. When low on health, do not stand in Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, use Braum W Stand Behind Me to leave its range before the stun triggers.
Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana's main damage. If being caught by Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana R Soul Shackles is getting you killed, you can get tenacity earlier. If your allied marksman is immobilized and focused down, get Mikael's Blessing earlier. Consider healing reduction if Morgana's healing is a problem in long fights.
Morgana.fight: Dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and start a fight when Morgana E Black Shield is down. When a gap opens between minions, apply a slow and the first mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then attack the same target as your allied marksman to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. Do not waste crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.laning: Keep the wave between you and Morgana to avoid Morgana Q Dark Binding. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when Morgana or the enemy marksman steps up to last hit. If Braum Q Winter's Bite lands, stack marks on the same target with your ally. If it misses, do not force your way in with basic attacks. Stay in lane to protect your allied marksman and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, apply a slow and the first mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite. Close the gap by jumping to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then stack Braum P Concussive Blows with your ally's basic attacks to stun the target.
Morgana.escape: Your opening to engage is immediately after you dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and catch her with Braum R Glacial Fissure. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, do not wait for the stun; use Braum W Stand Behind Me to leave its range.
Morgana.phase: Early on, Braum can start a trade with one Braum Q Winter's Bite, but keep an angle that lets you dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding. Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so stay near your allied marksman and focus on protection and crowd control.
Morgana.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy damage dealer, and face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming Morgana Q Dark Binding. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies engaging, placing its remaining slow zone along the enemy's follow-up route. If an ally is threatened, hit the enemy on them with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then jump to the ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to grant defensive stats.

Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns if it hits, but falls slowly, so dodge sideways when you see it coming. Nami R Tidal Wave also moves slowly; sidestep it and save Braum W Stand Behind Me for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow. Avoid fighting an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing head-on, and re-engage after it expires.
Nami.build: Prepare healing reduction first against the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow. The listed options are Executioner's Calling and Morellonomicon. Build magic resistance rather than armor against the magic damage from Nami Q Aqua Prison, Nami W Ebb and Flow, and Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing.
Nami.fight: Target Nami immediately after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. Land Braum Q Winter's Bite through a gap between minions to apply a slow and the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows, then attack the same target as your allied marksman to complete the stun. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, back off instead of forcing your way in.
Nami.laning: Establish vision and line up Braum Q Winter's Bite when Nami steps forward. Minions block Braum Q Winter's Bite, so throw it when a gap opens between them. Stay in lane to protect your allied marksman. If the enemy jungler comes in, slow their approach with Braum Q Winter's Bite and Braum E Unbreakable.
Nami.combo: Apply a slow and the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows to Nami with Braum Q Winter's Bite. If you knock her up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before she lands, then follow with basic attacks.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility ability, so immediately after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to engage. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave and save Braum W Stand Behind Me for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that may follow. Once her crowd control is down, close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and catch Nami with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Nami.phase: Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so protect allies who have scaled and fight alongside them.
Nami.teamfight: Stay beside your allied marksman, between them and the enemy damage dealer. Face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threats to block projectiles, and jump to your ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to increase their defensive stats. When enemies engage, use Braum R Glacial Fissure to break up their formation and place its remaining slow zone along their follow-up route.

Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line can lead to an engage and a stun, so keep minions between you and Nautilus to avoid it. After a trade, leave his basic attack range immediately to avoid being rooted by the first attack of Nautilus P Staggering Blow. If Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, do not stand on top of an ally.
Nautilus.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, Nautilus W Titan's Wrath, and Nautilus E Riptide. If Nautilus's crowd control catches your allied marksman and they are burst down, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Nautilus.fight: Close the gap and trade immediately after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Land Braum Q Winter's Bite between minions to apply a mark, and continue the fight when an ally can basic attack the same target. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, back off and wait for the next opening.
Nautilus.laning: Use minions to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and look for Braum Q Winter’s Bite when there’s a gap between minions or the enemy steps up for a last hit. Stay near your allied marksman and maintain vision around the river and bushes. If the enemy engages, use Braum W Stand Behind Me to get next to an ally, then raise Braum E Unbreakable toward the threat.
Nautilus.combo: Once Nautilus Q Dredge Line is used, apply a slow and the first mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite. Leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then add basic attack stacks. Signal your allied marksman to attack the same target. If Braum R Glacial Fissure knocks the target up, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before they land and follow with basic attacks to seek a stun.
Nautilus.escape: Immediately after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your window to close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me. If you knock him up with Braum R Glacial Fissure then, he cannot escape with Nautilus Q Dredge Line. Even when engaging, do not linger within basic attack range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow.
Nautilus.phase: Late in the game, your own damage is low, so focus on protecting allies who have scaled.
Nautilus.teamfight: Stay beside your allied marksman and wait for Nautilus to engage. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies coming in to split their formation. Use Braum W Stand Behind Me to reach your ally and grant defensive stats, then raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles from the enemy marksman. Do not stand on top of an ally while Nautilus R Depth Charge is available.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can easily root allies behind its first target, so don’t stand clustered together. If an enemy transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour comes close, Neeko R Pop Blossom’s windup may be hidden, so spread out in advance. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; protect the target you were watching.
Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Neeko Q Blooming Burst and Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. If your allied marksman can be rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then hit by Neeko R Pop Blossom, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier. If that combo results in death, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance.
Neeko.fight: Start a trade when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down or Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable. Apply a slow and mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then attack the same target as your ally to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Neeko comes in, knock her up with Braum R Glacial Fissure to stop her engage.
Neeko.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or Neeko steps up for a last hit. If it lands, attack the marked target with your allied marksman. If it misses, do not force your way in. Stand in front of your ally, watch for Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, and be ready to use Braum E Unbreakable in its direction.
Neeko.combo: Apply a slow and the first mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Use your basic attacks and your ally's to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. As Neeko comes in, knock her up with Braum R Glacial Fissure, then land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before she lands to keep the slow and marks going.
Neeko.escape: Immediately after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used is your chance to get close and trade.
Neeko.phase: Braum remains strong through the midgame as he builds defensive items, so fight beside your allied marksman. Late in the game, Braum's own damage is low, so focus on protecting allies who have scaled.
Neeko.teamfight: Stand between Neeko and your backline. If an enemy you suspect is disguised comes close, spread out with your allies in advance. If Neeko comes in while preparing Neeko R Pop Blossom, stop her engage with Braum R Glacial Fissure and place its lingering slow zone along the route of enemies following up. When an ally is threatened, slow the enemy with Braum Q Winter's Bite, reach your ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then raise Braum E Unbreakable toward the threat.

Pyke.watch: Watch for the pull from Pyke Q Bone Skewer and the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move sideways off the path he traveled. If you see the shark indicator from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, move toward your allies.
Pyke.build: Build armor rather than magic resistance against Pyke's damage. Because Pyke builds physical penetration and targets low health champions with Pyke R Death From Below, secure health first instead of adding only a little armor.
Pyke.fight: Apply the first stack to Pyke with Braum Q Winter's Bite and fight when your allied marksman can attack the same target. If you have dodged Pyke E Phantom Undertow or Pyke R Death From Below has not come back up, close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me to complete the stun.
Pyke.laning: Look for an angle to land Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or Pyke steps forward. If it misses, do not force your way in. After a trade, keep the retreating Pyke in vision to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.combo: Apply a slow and the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Complete the stun with basic attacks alongside your ally. When you have a chance to stop Pyke's movement, knock him up with Braum R Glacial Fissure, then land Braum Q Winter's Bite and basic attacks just before he lands.
Pyke.escape: Immediately after you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow sideways is your chance to engage. If Pyke R Death From Below is also down, approach with Braum W Stand Behind Me and catch him with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Pyke.phase: Late in the game, Braum's own damage is low, so protect allies who have scaled. Have low health allies targeted by Pyke R Death From Below move together behind the frontline.
Pyke.teamfight: Stay beside your allied marksman and guard Pyke's approach. When he comes in, slow his movement with Braum Q Winter's Bite and Braum R Glacial Fissure. Raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles, and keep your distance from low health allies so Pyke R Death From Below cannot chain between you.

Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so keep your distance before entering its range. When Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke, stay behind minions to reduce the damage you take from being hit behind them. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait for it to end or move to his side instead of attacking from the front.
Pantheon.build: Buy armor items first to build armor against Pantheon's main ability damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid investing heavily in health alone. Effects that reduce attack speed also help reduce Pantheon's basic attack damage.
Pantheon.fight: Land Braum Q Winter's Bite between minions to apply a slow and mark, then continue the fight only when an ally can basic attack the same target. While Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, wait for it to end instead of forcing damage through.
Pantheon.laning: Use Braum Q Winter's Bite when an enemy steps up for a last hit or a gap opens between minions. Stand behind minions when Pantheon uses Pantheon Q Comet Spear to poke, and stay out of range of Pantheon W Shield Vault. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, back off, wait for the next opening, and stay near your allied marksman.
Pantheon.combo: Mark Pantheon with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before he lands to continue the slow and marks.
Pantheon.escape: After Pantheon W Shield Vault is used, the risk of its targeted stun is lower. Confirm that Pantheon R Grand Starfall is also unavailable, then close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and prevent his escape with Braum R Glacial Fissure. If only one movement ability is down, account for the one he still has and do not chase too far.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon's impact falls off late in the game, but Braum's own damage is also low, so focus on protecting allies who have scaled.
Pantheon.teamfight: Stand between Pantheon and your backline, and place Braum R Glacial Fissure along the path of his engage with Pantheon W Shield Vault. Land Braum Q Winter's Bite on Pantheon once he closes in, then leap to an ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to grant defensive stats. If the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall appears, move out of its landing area. Raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threatening projectiles.

Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance shows its landing spot, so sidestep when Rakan starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness activates, avoid lining up with allies and use Braum R Glacial Fissure to cut off his path before he reaches you.
Rakan.build: Rakan's main threat is the crowd control he initiates with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, so prepare a way to cleanse it first. If you build resistance against his damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers breaks. Hit Braum Q Winter's Bite through an opening between minions to apply a slow and the first stack, then attack the same target as your ally to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows.
Rakan.laning: Look for a Braum Q Winter's Bite angle when Rakan steps up for a last hit or a gap opens between minions. If it misses, back off instead of forcing your way in for an auto attack, and wait until you can use it again. Stay near your AD carry and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Rakan.combo: After dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance, use Braum Q Winter's Bite to apply a slow and the first stack. Leap to a forward minion or an ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then build the stacks for the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows with your ally's auto attacks. If you knock the target up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Braum Q Winter's Bite just before they land to chain the crowd control.
Rakan.escape: Right after Rakan W Grand Entrance misses is your chance to close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me. If Rakan is away from his allies, he has no target to leap to with Rakan E Battle Dance, so catch him with Braum R Glacial Fissure then.
Rakan.phase: Braum stays strong through mid game as he builds defensive items, so fight alongside your AD carry. In late game, Braum has less impact if his allies have not scaled. The available information does not establish which of Braum or Rakan is stronger at each stage.
Rakan.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy damage dealers, and wait for Rakan to engage. If Rakan uses Rakan W Grand Entrance to go in, move out of the landing area and use Braum R Glacial Fissure to cut off Rakan and the enemy's follow-up route. Use Braum W Stand Behind Me to reach an ally and increase your defensive stats, then raise Braum E Unbreakable toward the direction the enemy marksman's projectiles are coming from.

Rell.watch: When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up both Rell and an ally, treat it as a signal that Rell is about to engage: stop trading and retreat beyond the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Sidestep Rell Q Shattering Strike, which travels in a straight line, and keep space between yourself and allies so Rell R Magnet Storm does not pull you in together.
Rell.build: Build magic resistance first because most of Rell's damage is magic damage. Rell P Break the Mold lowers resistances, and Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only a large amount of health.
Rell.fight: When a gap opens between minions, hit Rell with Braum Q Winter's Bite to apply a slow and the first stack. If it hits, attack the same target as your AD carry to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If it misses, back off.
Rell.laning: Stay beyond the short range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and harass her with Braum Q Winter's Bite when she steps up for a last hit. Rell has low magic resistance early and no way to restore health, so keep applying Braum's magic damage without letting her get into engage range.
Rell.combo: Apply the first stack to Rell with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or an ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Auto attack alongside your ally to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock Rell up with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Braum Q Winter's Bite just before she lands and follow with auto attacks.
Rell.escape: Right after Rell uses Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, create distance so she is left alone. When you go in, act before Rell E Full Tilt is available again: close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and lock her down with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Rell.phase: Early on, Braum can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, and Rell's low magic resistance makes her vulnerable to harass. Braum stays strong through mid game as he builds defensive items. In late game, focus on protecting allies who have scaled because Braum deals little damage himself.
Rell.teamfight: Wait beside your backline for Rell to engage, then use Braum R Glacial Fissure on her to break up the enemy formation. Slow Rell with Braum Q Winter's Bite if she reaches an ally, then leap to that ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to raise their defensive stats. Face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles from the enemy AD carry.

Renata.watch: Stand behind minions or your frontline: if Renata Glasc Q Handshake catches you, its throw can also stun an ally. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover hits you, you will attack nearby allies, so keep your distance from them when you are within its cast area. After taking down an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat so your allies are not killed.
Renata.build: Prioritize Mikael's Blessing sooner if an ability such as Renata Glasc Q Handshake threatens to catch your AD carry. Against Renata Glasc's damage, build magic resistance over armor, and use Braum W Stand Behind Me to raise your resistances and an ally's.
Renata.fight: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so look for a chance to close the gap. Hit Braum Q Winter's Bite between minions to apply a slow and the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows, then coordinate with an ally to attack the same target. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, do not force your way in for an auto attack.
Renata.laning: Look to hit Renata Glasc with Braum Q Winter's Bite when an enemy steps up for a last hit or a gap opens between minions. If it hits, build stacks with your AD carry and limit the space where Renata Glasc can stand forward. Stay near your ally and maintain vision of the river and bushes. When threatened, use Braum W Stand Behind Me toward your ally and face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles.
Renata.combo: Slow Renata Glasc and apply the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward ally or minion with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Use your auto attacks and your ally's to build the stacks for the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock her up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Braum Q Winter's Bite just before she lands and follow with auto attacks.
Renata.escape: Close the gap and engage when Renata Glasc Q Handshake is unavailable. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so use a forward ally or minion to leap in with Braum W Stand Behind Me and catch her with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Renata.phase: In mid game, Braum is effective at protecting allies as he builds defensive items. In late game, stay near your AD carry and focus on protection and crowd control because Braum deals little damage on his own.
Renata.teamfight: While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep space between yourself and allies to reduce the chance of being hit together. Stand between your backline and the enemy carries, face Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles, and use Braum R Glacial Fissure on engaging enemies to break up their formation. If you take down an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, create distance so nearby allies are not killed.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line through allies or minions, so move off the line between Senna and her target. If Senna W Last Embrace hits you, move away from allies before the root triggers. After Senna hits you once, retreat to deny her a second attack.
Senna.build: Build armor first against Senna's main damage, and build health alongside it. Prioritize Mikael's Blessing sooner if Senna W Last Embrace catches your AD carry.
Senna.fight: When Senna steps up to collect a soul or last hit, start a trade by hitting Braum Q Winter's Bite through a gap between minions. Attack the target with your AD carry to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, back off.
Senna.laning: Check in advance where souls will appear and harass Senna as she approaches to disrupt her collection. Move off the straight line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness, but keep minions between you and Senna when dodging Senna W Last Embrace. Stay near your AD carry, limit Senna's space, and maintain vision of the river and bushes.
Senna.combo: Slow Senna and apply the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Follow with your auto attacks and your ally's to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock her up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit Braum Q Winter's Bite just before she lands to continue the slow and stacks.
Senna.escape: Close the gap when Senna W Last Embrace misses and its root is no longer a threat. After the movement speed boost from Senna E Curse of the Black Mist ends, look for a chance to approach with Braum W Stand Behind Me and catch her with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Senna.phase: Early on, Braum can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite. Senna is weak then, so pressure her hard to stop her from collecting souls. Braum stays strong through mid game, but Senna's range and attack damage keep growing if left alone. In late game, focus on protecting allies who have scaled because Braum deals little damage himself.
Senna.teamfight: Stand between your backline and Senna, and face Braum E Unbreakable toward projectiles coming from her direction. When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to a place with vision or use Braum R Glacial Fissure in the mist to block her approach. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies who engage, then use its lingering slow area to cut off the path for enemies following them.

Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If slowed, move out of the line directly in front of Seraphine. In teamfights, spread out sideways so Seraphine R Encore cannot extend through allies to the backline.
Seraphine.build: Seraphine's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If abilities such as Seraphine E Beat Drop threaten to catch your ADC, buy Mikael's Blessing earlier.
Seraphine.fight: Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is used is your opening to engage. Find a clear angle between minions and land Braum Q Winter's Bite for the slow and first stack, then attack the same target as your ally to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows.
Seraphine.combo: Once Seraphine E Beat Drop is used, apply the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then jump to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Follow with your basic attacks and your ally's to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock her up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before she lands to keep the slow and stacks going.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility ability, so engage right after avoiding Seraphine E Beat Drop. Close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and knock her up with Braum R Glacial Fissure to make it hard for her to escape.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, Braum Q Winter's Bite can start trades, so look actively for openings. In late game, Braum deals little damage alone; protect your carries and attack the same target with them.
Seraphine.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy carries, and raise Braum E Unbreakable toward projectiles coming from Seraphine. Spread out sideways: if allies line up, Seraphine R Encore can extend its range. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure to break up an enemy engage, then jump to the ally you need to protect with Braum W Stand Behind Me.
Seraphine.laning: Trade when Seraphine is alone, separated from her allied marksman. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when the enemy steps up for a last hit or there is space between the minions. If it misses, don't force an engage.

Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns every ally it hits in a line, so spread out sideways from your allies when Sona steps forward. If she approaches suddenly with an empowered basic attack ready, back away and watch for the bonus damage or slow from Sona P Power Chord.
Sona.build: Sona's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Have at least one healing reduction item on your team to handle her late game healing.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to share an aura or last hit, land Braum Q Winter's Bite for the slow and first mark. Attack the same target as your ADC to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. Back off if Braum Q Winter's Bite misses.
Sona.laning: Force trades early, before Sona builds up her scaling stacks, so she has to spend mana on healing. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions, and maintain vision of the river and bushes while staying near your ADC.
Sona.combo: Apply the first mark and slow to Sona with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then jump to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Follow with basic attacks alongside your ally to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Sona looks ready to escape with Sona E Song of Celerity, knock her up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, then follow with Braum Q Winter's Bite and basic attacks just before she lands.
Sona.escape: When Sona R Crescendo is unavailable, you can engage without risking its stun. Look for a chance to knock her up with Braum R Glacial Fissure before Sona E Song of Celerity activates.
Sona.phase: In late game, Sona's permanent scaling and team healing grow stronger while Braum's own damage falls off, so focus on protecting your allies.
Sona.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy carries. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies engaging to cut off their formation and the path for follow-up. Jump to an ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to increase their defensive stats, and raise Braum E Unbreakable toward projectiles from the enemy ADC. If you disrupt Sona's position so she is separated from her allies, you can reduce the area reached by her healing, shield, and movement speed auras.

Soraka.watch: If Braum is hit by Soraka Q Starcall, he is slowed while Soraka gains healing and movement speed, making it hard to keep up damage pressure. Soraka E Equinox silences you inside its area and can root you if you stay too long, so use your mobility ability before stepping into it and get out. Soraka R Wish heals her allies, so do not engage based only on health you have worn down over time.
Soraka.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox. If healing prolongs fights, consider healing reduction next. Buy Mikael's Blessing earlier if Soraka E Equinox roots your ADC and they come under focused attack.
Soraka.fight: Engage as soon as Soraka E Equinox is used. Apply the slow and first mark to Soraka with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then attack the same target as your ADC to complete the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, do not force your way in for basic attacks.
Soraka.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when a gap opens between minions or Soraka steps up to last hit. Pressure her with your ADC to make her use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which costs Soraka health. Dodge Soraka Q Starcall to maintain that pressure.
Soraka.combo: Apply the slow and first mark to Soraka with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then jump to a forward ally or minion with Braum W Stand Behind Me. Follow with a basic attack and have your ADC attack Soraka too to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows.
Soraka.escape: Right after Soraka E Equinox is used to poke is your window to engage. Soraka has no mobility ability, so close the gap and knock her up with Braum R Glacial Fissure to hold her in place.
Soraka.phase: In the mid game, use Braum R Glacial Fissure and your defensive items to fight alongside your ADC. Late game, Braum lacks damage alone, so focus the target you mark with a scaled ally and deal damage in short bursts before Soraka R Wish can undo a long trade.
Soraka.teamfight: Stand between your backline and the enemy carries, and raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threats to block projectiles. If an enemy reaches an ally, slow them with Braum Q Winter's Bite and jump to your ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to add defensive stats. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure to cut off engaging enemies and their follow-up path. When you can reach Soraka, focus her with your allies.

Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and returns, so stay out of its path until it disappears completely, even after dodging the first pass. If rooted, you can be pulled in and hit by follow-up attacks. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with more overlapping bolts up close, so keep your distance. Leave the area when Swain R Demonic Ascension activates.
Swain.build: Swain's main attacks deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If you expect long fights, get healing reduction next to counter healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and Swain R Demonic Ascension. Buy Mikael's Blessing earlier if your ADC gets caught by Swain E Nevermove and focused down.
Swain.fight: Right after Swain E Nevermove is used, jump to an ally or minion with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. When a clear angle opens between minions, land Braum Q Winter's Bite for the slow and first stack, then attack the same target as your ADC to complete the stun. Do not force the engage if Braum Q Winter's Bite misses.
Swain.laning: Early on, before Swain builds stacks, start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite to take control of the lane. Cast it when an opponent steps up to last hit or a gap opens between minions, then attack the target you hit with your ADC. Maintain vision of the river and bushes, and stay near your ADC.
Swain.combo: Once Swain E Nevermove is used, apply the first stack and slow with Braum Q Winter's Bite. Jump to an ally or forward minion with Braum W Stand Behind Me, then stun the target with your basic attacks and your ally's.
Swain.escape: Swain has no mobility or escape ability, so right after Swain E Nevermove is used is your chance to engage. Dodge its returning pass too, then close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and use Braum R Glacial Fissure to cut off Swain's escape route.
Swain.phase: Early on, Braum can start fights well with Braum Q Winter's Bite, while Swain is weakest before building stacks. Braum stays strong through the mid game as he builds defensive items, but Swain grows stronger over time. Late game, account for Swain's healing and scaling: apply healing reduction and fight to protect your allies.
Swain.teamfight: Beside your ADC, slow engaging enemies with Braum Q Winter's Bite and jump to your ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to increase defensive stats. Raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles, and use Braum R Glacial Fissure to cut off the enemy formation and follow-up path. When Swain R Demonic Ascension activates, leave its area and reengage after it ends.

Taric.watch: When Taric E Dazzle is telegraphed, sidestep it. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and manage your position until it ends.
Taric.build: Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Magic resistance is more effective against this damage than armor.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, land Braum Q Winter's Bite to slow him and apply the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows. Close in to complete the stun when your allied ADC can attack the same target. Keep Taric away from targets he can basic attack to delay his ability rotations.
Taric.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when gaps open between minions or an opponent steps up for a last hit. If you draw out and dodge Taric E Dazzle, trade with your ally; if Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, back off. Avoid taking Taric's early melee damage for free, and hold space in front of your allied ADC.
Taric.combo: Apply the first stack to Taric with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Complete the Braum P Concussive Blows stun with your basic attacks and your ally's. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before he lands to continue the slow and stacks.
Taric.escape: The opening to engage comes after Taric E Dazzle is used. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and pin him down with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Taric.phase: Early on, you can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but avoid Taric's strong melee basic attacks. Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so focus on protecting your scaled allies.
Taric.teamfight: From between your backline and the enemy damage dealers, use Braum R Glacial Fissure on engaging enemies to break up their formation. Crowd control still works while Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is active, so lock down the enemy with Braum R Glacial Fissure during that time and let your allies attack again once the immunity ends. When the enemy ranged carry's projectiles come in, raise Braum E Unbreakable in front of your allies toward their direction.

Thresh.watch: Thresh Q Death Sentence has a long cast animation, but a hit stuns you and lets Thresh dash in, so sidestep as soon as he raises his scythe. Stay out of the line between Thresh and his allies to avoid being pulled toward them by Thresh E Flay.
Thresh.build: Prioritize magic resistance items against Thresh's ability damage. Also build tenacity, since damage from his allies while you are caught by Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay is dangerous.
Thresh.fight: After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, close the gap while Thresh W Dark Passage is also unavailable. Apply a slow and the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then attack the same target as your ally to complete the Braum P Concussive Blows stun.
Thresh.laning: Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when gaps open between minions or Thresh steps up to collect a soul. If it hits, stack Braum P Concussive Blows with your allied ADC; if it misses, do not force an approach. Stay in lane to protect your ally and maintain vision of the river and brush.
Thresh.combo: Apply the first stack to Thresh with Braum Q Winter's Bite, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me and trigger the Braum P Concussive Blows stun with your basic attacks alongside your ally's. If Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh W Dark Passage are unavailable, knock him up with Braum R Glacial Fissure, then follow with Braum Q Winter's Bite and basic attacks just before he lands.
Thresh.escape: Do not engage just because Thresh Q Death Sentence is unavailable. When Thresh W Dark Passage is also unavailable, close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and block his escape with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Thresh.phase: Early on, you can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but Thresh will grow increasingly durable if you let him collect souls freely. Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so focus on protecting your scaled allies.
Thresh.teamfight: From beside your backline, use Braum R Glacial Fissure on engaging enemies, placing its lingering slow zone along the path of enemy reinforcements. Leap to an ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to increase defensive stats, and raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming projectiles from the enemy ADC. If caught in Thresh R The Box, choose a direction to break through and have your tankiest ally cross one wall first.

Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission also hits to either side after splitting, so don’t dodge only sideways: move in toward Vel'Koz or retreat behind where it has already passed. To block it with Braum E Unbreakable, raise your shield in time facing the direction the beam is coming from. If you’re hit in succession by Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption as well, Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction deals its true damage. When you get marked with stacks, back off and let them wear off.
Velkoz.build: Build magic resistance first against Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, Vel'Koz W Void Rift, and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, so build health as well. Movement speed also helps you leave telegraphed attack areas.
Velkoz.fight: Close in on Vel'Koz after dodging or drawing out Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Land Braum Q Winter's Bite through a gap between minions to slow him and apply the first stack of Braum P Concussive Blows, then have your ally basic attack the same target. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, do not force a chase.
Velkoz.laning: Look for an angle on Braum Q Winter's Bite when Vel'Koz steps up for a last hit or gaps open between minions. If Vel'Koz's repeated poke builds stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction, retreat behind minions and let them expire. Maintain vision of the river and tri-brush to create a route for approaching from the side, and stay beside your allied ADC.
Velkoz.combo: Once Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is unavailable, apply the first stack with Braum Q Winter's Bite and leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Then complete Braum P Concussive Blows with your basic attacks and your ally's to stun him. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before he lands to continue the slow and stacks.
Velkoz.escape: The moment after Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is used is your chance to engage. Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so leap to an ally or forward minion with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap, then limit his escape route with Braum R Glacial Fissure. If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is still available, prepare a way to finish him despite the possibility of being knocked away after you get close.
Velkoz.phase: Early on, Braum can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but avoid triggering Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction by taking consecutive hits. Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so protect your scaled allies and chain your stun and knockup.
Velkoz.teamfight: Stand between your allied ADC and Vel'Koz, and raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting it with the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure or the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. Place the lingering slow zone from Braum R Glacial Fissure along the path of enemy reinforcements.

Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so change direction and sidestep when you see him charging it. Leave the telegraphed area of Xerath W Eye of Destruction, and raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming Xerath E Shocking Orb, whose stun can leave you open to follow-up attacks. Start dodging as soon as you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane's cast animation.
Xerath.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Xerath's attacks. Also get movement speed from items to leave telegraphed attack areas, but prioritize blocking the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb with Braum E Unbreakable.
Xerath.fight: The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is your chance to close the gap. Land Braum Q Winter's Bite through an open gap between minions to slow him and apply the first mark, then engage together when your ally can basic attack the same target. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, do not force an approach.
Xerath.laning: Xerath Q Arcanopulse can hit you behind minions, so sidestep when he starts charging it. Start a trade with Braum Q Winter's Bite when an opponent steps up for a last hit or gaps open between minions. Otherwise, stay beside your allied ADC and maintain vision of the river and brush. Avoid heavy damage and wait until Xerath runs low on mana, then push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.combo: Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are unavailable, apply a mark with Braum Q Winter's Bite and leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Then basic attack the same target as your ally to complete the Braum P Concussive Blows stun. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, land Braum Q Winter's Bite just before he lands and follow with basic attacks.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so engage immediately after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used. Leap to an ally or minion with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap, then block Xerath's retreat with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Xerath.phase: Early on, you can start trades with Braum Q Winter's Bite, but you need to avoid Xerath's long range and coordinate with your ally to attack the marked target. Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so focus on protecting your scaled allies.
Xerath.teamfight: Stand between your backline and Xerath, and raise Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming Xerath E Shocking Orb. If a threat reaches an ally, slow it with Braum Q Winter's Bite and leap to your ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to increase defensive stats. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure to knock up engaging enemies and slow the path of reinforcements.

Zilean.watch: Two Zilean Q Time Bombs on the same target cause a stun. As soon as the first bomb attaches, separate from your allies and leave the blast area. Do not engage alone, to avoid being slowed by Zilean E Time Warp and taking bombs in succession. Do not use abilities on a target under Zilean R Chronoshift while they are reviving; wait for its duration to end or strike immediately after they revive.
Zilean.build: Prioritize tenacity against the slow from Zilean E Time Warp and the stun from Zilean Q Time Bomb. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance afterward. Using Braum W Stand Behind Me to reach an ally just before an attack also raises both your magic resistance and theirs.
Zilean.fight: When Zilean steps up for a last hit or a gap opens between minions, use Braum Q Winter's Bite to slow him and apply the first stack. Immediately attack the same target as your allies to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If Braum Q Winter's Bite misses, back off instead of forcing an engage.
Zilean.laning: Braum stays in lane to protect his ally and maintains vision around the river and bushes.
Zilean.combo: Hit Zilean with Braum Q Winter's Bite to slow him and apply the first stack, then leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap. Basic attack alongside your allies to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock him up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit him with Braum Q Winter's Bite just before he lands to follow up with the slow and a stack.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility ability, so engage with your allies after he uses both Zilean Q Time Bombs or when Zilean E Time Warp is down. Use an ally or minion to close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me, and block Zilean's retreat path with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Zilean.teamfight: Stay near your marksman and point Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threats. Use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies who engage to break their formation. If an enemy under Zilean R Chronoshift is hard to finish, switch to Zilean himself, who is fragile and has no mobility ability. If a bomb attaches to an ally, move away so you are not both caught in the stun.

Zyra.watch: Sidestep the straight-line root from Zyra E Grasping Roots at the edge of its range. Zyra R Stranglethorns knocks up after a delay once the vines appear, so leave the area when you see its indicator. Use Braum W Stand Behind Me to escape if needed. Back off briefly instead of fighting where there are many plants.
Zyra.build: Get Mikael's Blessing earlier because an allied marksman caught by Zyra E Grasping Roots can take damage from her plants. Build magic resistance over armor against Zyra's main damage.
Zyra.fight: After drawing out Zyra E Grasping Roots and sidestepping it, trade where there are no plants. Hit Braum Q Winter's Bite through a gap between minions to slow the target and apply the first stack. Attack the same target as your marksman to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows.
Zyra.laning: When Zyra uses an ability to grow seeds, do not walk in to step on them. Dodge the ability, then clear the seeds. Look for Braum Q Winter's Bite when an opponent steps up for a last hit or the minions spread apart. If it misses, do not force an engage. Stay near your marksman and maintain river and brush vision.
Zyra.combo: Once Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, use Braum Q Winter's Bite to slow the target and apply the first stack. Leap to a forward minion or ally with Braum W Stand Behind Me to close the gap, then basic attack the same target alongside your allies to trigger the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. If you knock the target up first with Braum R Glacial Fissure, hit them with Braum Q Winter's Bite just before they land to follow up with the slow and a stack.
Zyra.escape: Dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots creates an opening to engage. Zyra has no mobility ability to create distance, so close the gap with Braum W Stand Behind Me and catch her with Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Zyra.phase: Braum stays strong through midgame as defensive items accumulate, so look for moments when Zyra has no plants. Late game, Braum deals little damage on his own, so protect your scaled allies and fight alongside them.
Zyra.teamfight: Do not take a fight where Zyra has built up seeds and plants; move the fight elsewhere. Stand between your backline and the enemy damage dealers, point Braum E Unbreakable toward incoming threats, and use Braum R Glacial Fissure on enemies who engage to break their formation.
